label: Velya Alarm Automation
info:
# Velya Cloud Relay - Node-RED Integration Example

This flow demonstrates:
- Calculating next alarm time (21:00 tonight or tomorrow)
- Creating alarm via REST API
- Handling webhook delivery confirmation
- Error handling and retry logic

## Setup:
1. Configure the Velya Config node with your:
   - Server URL (e.g., https://relay.velya.app)
   - API Key (from node_red_keys table)
   - Device ID (from iOS app Settings → Advanced)
2. Deploy the flow
3. Inject manually to test, or schedule with cron/inject node

## Flow Structure:
- **Calculate Next 21h**: Determines if 21:00 is today or tomorrow
- **Create Alarm API Call**: POST to /v1/alarms
- **Webhook Receiver**: Listens for delivery confirmation
- **Error Handler**: Logs failures and retries

📋 SETUP REQUIRED: Configure environment variables in Node-RED settings
info:
Add to Node-RED's settings.js:

```javascript
functionGlobalContext: {
    VELYA_SERVER_URL: "https://relay.velya.app",
    VELYA_API_KEY: "your-api-key-here",
    VELYA_DEVICE_ID: "E621E1F8-C36C-495A-93FC-0C247A3E6E5F",
    VELYA_WEBHOOK_BASE: "https://your-nodered.com"
}
```

Or set via environment variables:
```bash
export VELYA_SERVER_URL=https://relay.velya.app
export VELYA_API_KEY=your-api-key-here
export VELYA_DEVICE_ID=your-device-id
export VELYA_WEBHOOK_BASE=https://your-nodered.com
```

name: ⏰ Trigger: Daily at 20:50 (10 min before alarm) or manual inject
info:
The flow calculates if 21:00 is tonight or tomorrow:
- If before 21:00 → alarm for tonight
- If after 21:00 → alarm for tomorrow

name: 🔔 Webhook: Receives delivery confirmation from Velya relay
info:
When the alarm is delivered to the device, Velya sends a POST to the webhook_url:

POST /velya-webhook
{
  "event": "alarm.delivered",
  "alarm_id": "uuid",
  "device_id": "uuid",
  "delivered_at": "ISO timestamp",
  "delivery_method": "websocket" | "apns"
}

You can use this to trigger follow-up automation (e.g., log to database, send notification, etc.)
